preconditions.description: The input contains at least one integer (t).
The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, n is between 1 and 100, and each cost a_i is between 1 and 10^9, as per problem statement.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(lambda i, costs: min_coins_for_any(costs) == int(stdout.strip().split()[i]) for i, costs in enumerate(parse_test_cases(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum total number of coins (of values 1, 2, 3) required to form exact change for every cost in that test case's list.
